THE COMPANY

An established foundation.
A specialist new chapter.

From Mother Earth Movers and Infra Pvt. Ltd. to Gravita Ground Engineering Pvt. Ltd. — execution heritage, with a sharper specialist focus.

Progress built
on capability.

Over the years, the journey has steadily expanded technical capability, strengthened execution, deepened service offerings and built lasting market credibility. Gravita carries that experience into a concentrated scope of subsurface and retained-earth works.

Our focus

Specialist ground engineering, deep excavation, earth retention, basement construction and ground-support works.

Our strength

Technical expertise, disciplined execution and equipment-led delivery.

Our model

Scale through stronger capability, visibility and larger project participation.

Our commitment

Engineered solutions with a focus on safety, reliability and long-term performance.

EXECUTION LEADERSHIP

Mr. K. Manikandan

Director · Entrepreneurial Leadership & Operations

The profile records 25+ years of entrepreneurial and operational experience across earthmoving, top-down and deep excavation, infrastructure development, material supply and construction execution, with deep expertise in Chennai’s infrastructure sector.

His leadership spans manpower coordination, equipment deployment and day-to-day delivery oversight. The profile cites excavation up to 28 ft in a metro project and foundation works up to 40 m depth.
